artifact.title: Holder and Zygmund Spectra of the Rvachev--Thue--Morse Operator
artifact.subtitle: Finite Fourier reduction, critical Jordan chains, and optimal decay

principal_source.title: Sharp C^r Spectral Disks for the Rvachev--Thue--Morse Transfer Operator

repository.snapshot_note: The article records the same principal-source blob at a later independently inspected branch head. This package pins its references to the commit specified above.

starting_questions: Determine the noninteger Holder, little-Holder, and Zygmund spectra.
Determine the critical classical C^1 eigenspace at -1/4 and its generalized eigenvectors.
Develop finite Fourier reduction for general finite trigonometric Markov masks.
inherited_background: The Rvachev--Thue--Morse operator and the normalization L=P/2.
The known integer C^r spectral-disk result.
The elementary three-mode eigenfunctions and their spectral values.
The endpoint-jet algebra used in the earlier integer-regularity report.
The explicit research questions motivating this extension.
arguments_supplied_relative_to_baseline: A shifted approximation seminorm giving an exact quotient contraction after removal of a finite Fourier core.
The periodic spectral and point-spectrum classification for every positive Holder--Zygmund order and its little counterpart.
Finite-core exterior spectral exhaustion for every nonnegative finite trigonometric Markov mask with integer dilation b>=2.
The complete big/little boundary generalized-eigenspace classification and the extra big-space Jordan level.
Exact residual operator-power orders, including critical polynomial loss.
The critical classical C^1 generalized-eigenspace conclusion and the noninteger Rvachev interval extension.
A higher-frequency mask with fractional resonance thresholds, exact finite verification, and proposed research directions.

scope.arbitrary_finite_mask_theorems: Periodic spaces; nonnegative real trigonometric weights satisfying the Markov normalization; integer dilation b>=2.
scope.rvachev_periodic_theorems: All positive Holder--Zygmund orders, their little spaces, and the separately stated critical classical C^1 generalized eigenspace.
scope.rvachev_interval_theorems: Noninteger Holder orders and their little spaces, plus the stated critical classical C^1 generalized eigenspace.
not_settled: Sharp local classical C^1 resolvent growth at -1/4.
Weighted endpoints and unrestricted infinite Fourier tails.
The further research questions listed in the article.

validation_scope.proof_method: Conventional mathematical proofs, with independent nonmechanized review and separate exact finite checks.

literature_and_reuse_note: The manuscript bibliography credits classical transfer-operator, essential-radius, and approximation results. The inherited/new distinction is relative to the pinned repository baseline and is not a certification of worldwide priority.
